en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, no author known. 'Џан џигер' is a Turkish endearment; 'дафино' per the source note likely means olive-green; 'ча пукнем' I read as 'I will burst (from longing)', my reading.

words_to_learn.en: embroidered with gold or silver thread
front panel of a folk costume

lines.en: (Come, I will buy you an embroidered vest)

lines.cyr: - Ајде ќе ти купим срмени јелек,
lines.lat: - Ajde ḱe ti kupim srmeni jelek,
lines.en: - Come, I will buy you an embroidered vest,

lines.cyr: за тебе, Магдо, за тебе душо.
lines.lat: za tebe, Magdo, za tebe dušo.
lines.en: for you, Magda, for you, my soul.

lines.cyr: - Ај што ќе ми мене срмени јелек,
lines.lat: - Aj što ḱe mi mene srmeni jelek,
lines.en: - Oh, what do I need an embroidered vest for,

lines.cyr: без тебе лудо, без тебе младо?
lines.lat: bez tebe ludo, bez tebe mlado?
lines.en: without you, foolish one, without you, young one?

lines.cyr: Без тебе, ча пукнем, лудо младо,
lines.lat: Bez tebe, ča puknem, ludo mlado,
lines.en: Without you, I will burst, foolish young one,

lines.cyr: - Ајде ќе ти купим дафино пеше
lines.lat: - Ajde ḱe ti kupim dafino peše
lines.en: - Come, I will buy you an olive-colored apron front
